spec.populations: names held by the repair arm at BOTH ends of the window (no swap, so E100's entrant/exit lists cannot see them)
spec.cell: mean over the era's windows of 100*(mean_gap_read - mean_unscreened_read) in bp, on the same names and dates
spec.additivity: each name contributes 100*(g_u - u_u)/n, so the pieces sum to the window delta; residual published, never assumed 0
spec.e105_column: largest_single_name_read = the name with the biggest absolute read in the window, with its share of that window's mean -- a level over few transitions is a mean over few names and must be published with it

cells.skipped: no decision ends for this era/book
no decision ends for this era/book

implausible_reads.reading: a read past +/-100% in one window is a print artefact, not a return; both arms are counted because the repair is not automatically the plausible side

answers.reading: a split print does sit inside unchanged holdings on 4 of 6 cells; the largest is 2024_now/me at 15.2

honest: descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict on the strategy, no prereg, no trial count, no ledger booking
the population is the REPAIR arm's persistent names; where the two arms hold different names the unscreened arm's own persistent set is not measured here (that is E100's swap face, not this one)
an equal-weight mean of name-level reads is not a portfolio return
a split read is inferred from the shape of the read plus the repair's own report, not proven against a vendor corporate-action file
